defects.problem: The opening right-hand rest lasts a quaver, not the whole first crotchet beat. The right hand already enters on the second half of beat one, so describing a full first-beat rest followed simply by later-beat chords misstates the central syncopation.
defects.evidence: Independently inspected printed p.13 / PDF p.12 of https://s9.imslp.org/files/imglnks/usimg/f/fe/IMSLP03060-Schumann-Op015Brt6016.pdf at enlarged scale. https://storage.gmth.de/proceedings/articles/117/pdf/gmth-proceedings-artikel-117.pdf figures3–6 analyse the displaced right-hand grouping against the left-hand3/4 layer.
defects.fix: Specify the initial quaver rest and offbeat right-hand entry against the left-hand pulse; remove the whole-first-beat-rest assertion and the implication that all chords simply fall on later crotchet beats. Preserve the valid repeat/form evidence and timing.
